title: Delete or fix the redundant weak step-count assertion in add_track_flow_screen_l1_test.dart

evidence.quote: 'self-paced Chumash step count is >= 5 (includes all self-paced steps)',

why: The test name claims '>= 5', the inline comment says the real count is '6', but the assertion only requires '>= 4' — three different numbers for one check. The very next test ('self-paced Chumash shows exactly 6 total steps', line 383) already asserts the precise, correct invariant (== 6), making this one both weaker than its own documentation and fully redundant.
recommendation: Delete this test (superseded by the exact-6 test immediately below it), or tighten its assertion to match its name/comment.
acceptance_criteria: Only the exact-count assertion remains for this scenario
